payload.title: Expand git-native conformance coverage for fleet edge cases
payload.body: The 10 active properties prove collision-free claims, fencing, leases, blocked-by, idempotent projection. Add properties for the untested scenarios that matter at fleet scale: large-log fold performance, compaction racing a concurrent claim, clock skew / non-monotonic time on lease expiry, heartbeat under contention, and fencing rejecting a stale owners heartbeat after a steal.
